name: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Limited
summary: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Limited engages in the manufacturing of stainless-steel pipes, tubes, and carbon steel pipes in India and internationally. The company offers stainless steel products, such as heat exchanger tubes, instrumentation seamless tubes, and stainless-steel pipes; nickel alloy seamless heat exchanger tubes; titanium welded tubes; carbon steel products, including ERW pipes and SAW pipes; pipe coating solutions; and spools, induction bends, fittings, hangers, and engineered support systems.
